notes.title: Introducing Operation: Fallen Eagle
notes.notes:
Hello everyone.

I would like to introduce the latest experimental project currently being developed by our team.

Commander supporters of our studio on [url=https://www.patreon.com/drakelinglabs]Patreon[/url] (as well as Platoon Leader supporters on [url=https://discord.com/servers/operation-harsh-doorstop-93829266994638848]Discord[/url]) will receive Steam keys to this project and the project playtest.

These keys can be redeemed [url=https://rewards.bluedrake42.com/welcome-packages/?for_bracket=0900000012]here for Commanders[/url], and [url=https://rewards.bluedrake42.com/welcome-packages/?for_bracket=0900000008]here for Platoon Leaders[/url].

We look forward to releasing more information to you as it becomes relevant.

Thank you.
